source._comment: Georgia has NO party registration -> turnout-only. The GA SoS 'Election Data Hub - Unofficial Turnout' publishes early-in-person + absentee + election-day turnout by county, but only through an interactive S3-hosted mashup app behind Cloudflare; no persistent public flat file was found off-season. STAGED SKELETON: writes 0 until a verified live 2026 feed is wired. The Friday rollout routine captures the live data-layer endpoint and finalizes the parser when GA early voting opens (~mid-Oct). Turnout-only: 'cast' = ballots cast; the map shades by turnout %.
